# Documentation requirements

- Use one top-level `#` heading per document and nest sections with `##` and `###`.
- Keep prose concise; prefer short lists and tables over long paragraphs.
- Add a language identifier to every fenced code block.
- Use relative links for in-repo references and verify that they resolve.
- Prefer Mermaid when a small diagram explains a structure or flow better than prose.
- Update user-facing documentation when the behavior it describes changes.
